- Auto-renew notice: our default is 90 days for standard order forms, but we can be flexible for pilots or smaller ARR. If Taldor can confirm the committed spend band, we can propose 60 days for this order.
- TFC: Redwood generally limits TFC for multi-year committed discounts because of capacity planning, but we can discuss a TFC with a pro-rated unwind and an early-exit fee that preserves the economics for our GPU reservations.

From a revenue ops perspective, 60-day auto-renew is acceptable if we remove the automatic price protection window (i.e., pricing can be adjusted at renewal with notice).

On TFC: recommend two options to present to Taldor (we should give them a choice):
A) TFC allowed with 60-day notice + pro-rated refund of unused pre-paid months but Redwood retains a 2-month early termination fee to cover reserved capacity.
B) No unilateral TFC, but mutual termination for convenience (either party) with 90-day notice and standard wind-down credits.

Team — reviewed Helen's redline and Karthik's options. Legal comments:

- We can accept a 60-day notice for auto-renew on this order if we add: (i) explicit notice period start tied to invoice date; and (ii) a clause preserving Redwood's right to apply a renewal-rate adjustment with 30 days' notice.
- For TFC, recommend offering Option A above but clarify calculation for pro-rata refund and the carve-out for non-cancellable resources. Suggested text included in Drive doc (see link).
- Also add a transition assistance section: 30 days of reduced-cost export assistance and access to logs for a clean cutover. This reduces operational risk and is often requested by procurement.

I uploaded a tracked-change draft to the Drive. Please review before I send the counter to Helen. If we want to be more conservative, we can propose a 75-day notice instead of 60 to protect capacity planning, but I'm okay with 60 if sales approves.

Helen — thanks for the patience. Attached is our counterproposal summary and a tracked-change MSA in Drive. High-level:

- Auto-renew: Redwood agrees to a 60-day notice for this order. Notice period will be measured from the invoice date; renewal pricing may be adjusted with 30 days' notice.
- TFC: We can offer a TFC with 60-day notice plus a pro-rated refund of unused pre-paid months. To protect our reservation economics, we will retain a two-month early termination fee for committed spend.
- Transition assistance: 30 days of export/hand-off support at no additional cost (logs and runbook access).

- Karthik will confirm the final early-exit fee wording and the committed-spend thresholds for the two-month retention.
- Helen / Daniel to confirm acceptance or provide counter-proposal by 2026-09-24 so procurement can route for signature.
